$Comment: What a contract on Old Jack's board, or an errand on his errands board, pays on top of the flat
Hallow Sweets every job lists in its own rewards. Every roll is read on its own: the last always
pays, and the three before it are chances. Chance is a percent from 0 to 100.
The first roll is the sweets bonus, anywhere from none to twelve, each amount as likely as the
next: it lands 12 times in 13 (Chance 92.3077) and then draws one of Hallows_Eve_Board_Sweets's
twelve amounts, so missing it is the thirteenth outcome. A wallet amount has no range of its own
the way an item's Count and CountMax do, which is why the bonus is drawn from a table.
Sweets and festival tokens (what every season pays) pay through the Currency reward kind, since
a counter wallet has no item to hand over. A companion mod adds its own rolls to this table with
a file of its own that names it in ContributesTo, so nothing here has to change.
Name: Hallows_Eve_Board_Pay
